name: Palladous-Shoal
description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by dust seas stretching to the horizon and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the escape pod debris field are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
